description:
Edge inputs: separate calls split at `#--call-- DIR` markers. Only the working directory crosses
calls; each case changes it (or fails to) a different way, or checks that some other state does
not carry, or carries state the supported way, through files.

Every marker names the directory Bash ends the previous call in.

cases.name: edge calls: cd relative from root
edge calls: cd dot-dot
edge calls: cd dash
edge calls: cd in a subshell does not carry
edge calls: cd in a pipeline stage does not carry
edge calls: cd in a function carries
edge calls: cd in command substitution does not carry
edge calls: cd through eval carries
edge calls: cd in a sourced file carries
edge calls: cd in the EXIT trap
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; trap 'cd /tmp/w' EXIT; echo body
#--call-- /tmp/w
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd in the ERR trap
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; trap 'cd /tmp/w' ERR; false; echo after
#--call-- /tmp/w
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd then exit in a function
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; f() { cd /tmp/w; exit 4; }; f
#--call-- /tmp/w
echo $?; pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd then errexit
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; set -e; cd /tmp/w; false; cd /
#--call-- /tmp/w
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd then nounset failure
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; set -u; cd /tmp/w; echo $nope; cd /
#--call-- /tmp/w
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd then exec
edge calls: cd then command not found
edge calls: cd then parameter error
edge calls: failed cd stays
edge calls: cd to a file stays
edge calls: cd with no HOME stays
edge calls: cd empty argument
edge calls: pushd carries
edge calls: pushd then popd
edge calls: CDPATH lookup carries
edge calls: CDPATH does not carry
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/c/sub; CDPATH=/tmp/c
#--call--
cd sub; echo $?; pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd -P through a symlink
edge calls: cd through a symlink then pwd -P
cases.script:
mkdir /tmp/real; ln -s real /tmp/link; cd /tmp/link; pwd
#--call-- /tmp/link
pwd -P

cases.name: edge calls: cd symlink dot-dot logical
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/a/b; ln -s a/b /tmp/l; cd /tmp/l/..; pwd
#--call-- /tmp
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd -P symlink dot-dot
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/a/b; ln -s a/b /tmp/l; cd -P /tmp/l/..; pwd
#--call-- /tmp/a
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd unicode directory
cases.script:
mkdir -p '/tmp/日本/é'; cd '/tmp/日本/é'
#--call-- /tmp/日本/é
pwd; ls ..

cases.name: edge calls: cd directory with spaces
cases.script:
mkdir -p '/tmp/a b/c d'; cd '/tmp/a b/c d'
#--call-- /tmp/a b/c d
pwd; echo "$PWD"

cases.name: edge calls: cd directory with glob characters
edge calls: cd trailing slash
edge calls: cd dot components
edge calls: cd dot-dot at root
edge calls: cd double slash
edge calls: cd deep
edge calls: command cd carries
edge calls: builtin cd carries
edge calls: sh -c cd does not carry
edge calls: bash -c cd does not carry
edge calls: find -exec cd does not carry
edge calls: xargs cd does not carry
edge calls: cd in a while pipeline does not carry
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; echo /tmp/w | while read -r d; do cd "$d"; done
#--call--
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd in lastpipe carries
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; shopt -s lastpipe; echo /tmp/w | while read -r d; do cd "$d"; done
#--call-- /tmp/w
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd in process substitution does not carry
edge calls: cd in a background job does not carry
edge calls: cd in a brace group carries
edge calls: cd in an if condition
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; if cd /tmp/w; then :; fi
#--call-- /tmp/w
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd in a for loop
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/a/b/c; for d in /tmp/a /tmp/a/b /tmp/a/b/c; do cd $d; done
#--call-- /tmp/a/b/c
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd in a case arm
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; case x in x) cd /tmp/w;; esac
#--call-- /tmp/w
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: cd in and-list after failure
edge calls: cd in or-list after failure
edge calls: cd with redirection
edge calls: cd with a failing redirection
edge calls: assigning PWD does not move
edge calls: assigning PWD after cd
edge calls: unset PWD after cd
edge calls: readonly PWD
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; cd /tmp; readonly PWD; cd /tmp/w; echo $?
#--call-- /tmp/w
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: OLDPWD assignment then cd dash
edge calls: exit in a subshell keeps cd
edge calls: return at top level
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; cd /tmp/w; return 3; echo after
#--call-- /tmp/w
echo $?; pwd

cases.name: edge calls: OLDPWD does not carry
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; cd /tmp/w; cd /tmp
#--call-- /tmp
cd -; echo $?; pwd

cases.name: edge calls: PWD is the new directory
edge calls: directory stack does not carry
edge calls: noclobber does not carry
cases.script:
echo a > /tmp/f; set -C
#--call--
echo b > /tmp/f; cat /tmp/f

cases.name: edge calls: noglob does not carry
edge calls: failglob does not carry
edge calls: nullglob does not carry
edge calls: extglob off in a new call
edge calls: IFS does not carry
edge calls: PATH does not carry
edge calls: hash table does not carry
cases.script:
hash ls 2>/dev/null; hash -p /x/fake cat
#--call--
hash; echo status=$?

cases.name: edge calls: exported function does not carry
cases.script:
f() { echo f; }; export -f f
#--call--
type f; echo status=$?

cases.name: edge calls: LINENO restarts
edge calls: BASH_REMATCH does not carry
edge calls: PIPESTATUS does not carry
edge calls: open descriptors do not carry
edge calls: exec stdout redirect does not carry
cases.script:
exec > /tmp/o; echo hidden
#--call--
echo shown; cat /tmp/o

cases.name: edge calls: jobs do not carry
cases.script:
{ echo bg > /tmp/o; } & wait
#--call--
jobs; echo "[$!]"; cat /tmp/o

cases.name: edge calls: set -x does not carry
edge calls: set -v does not carry
edge calls: pipefail does not carry
edge calls: nocasematch does not carry
edge calls: getopts state does not carry
cases.script:
set -- -a -b; getopts ab o; echo $o $OPTIND
#--call--
echo "[$OPTIND]"

cases.name: edge calls: SHLVL each call
edge calls: shift does not carry
cases.script:
set -- a b c; shift
#--call--
echo $#

cases.name: edge calls: integer attribute does not carry
edge calls: nameref does not carry
edge calls: local-only variable does not carry
cases.script:
f() { local v=1; g=2; }; f
#--call--
echo "[${v-unset}] [${g-unset}]"

cases.name: edge calls: environment export does not carry
edge calls: set +o restores options
cases.script:
set -o pipefail -o noclobber; set +o > /tmp/opts
#--call--
. /tmp/opts; set -o | grep -E '^(pipefail|noclobber)'

cases.name: edge calls: shopt -p restores shopts
cases.script:
shopt -s nullglob extglob; shopt -p nullglob extglob > /tmp/sh
#--call--
. /tmp/sh; shopt nullglob extglob

cases.name: edge calls: alias -p restores aliases
cases.script:
alias ll='echo long'; alias -p > /tmp/al
#--call--
shopt -s expand_aliases; . /tmp/al
ll

cases.name: edge calls: trap -p restores traps
cases.script:
trap 'echo bye' EXIT; trap -p > /tmp/tr
#--call--
. /tmp/tr; echo body

cases.name: edge calls: declare -p restores arrays
edge calls: export -p restores exports
cases.script:
export Q=1; export -p | grep ' Q=' > /tmp/ex
#--call--
. /tmp/ex; sh -c 'echo $Q'

cases.name: edge calls: declare -f restores functions
cases.script:
f() { echo "f:$1"; }; declare -f f > /tmp/fn
#--call--
. /tmp/fn; f arg

cases.name: edge calls: saved cwd restored
edge calls: counter file across calls
edge calls: append across calls
cases.script:
echo one > /tmp/log
#--call--
echo two >> /tmp/log
#--call--
echo three >> /tmp/log; cat /tmp/log

cases.name: edge calls: relative files follow the directory
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; cd /tmp/w; echo data > rel
#--call-- /tmp/w
cat rel; cd x
#--call-- /tmp/w/x
cat ../rel

cases.name: edge calls: remove in a later call
cases.script:
echo x > /tmp/f
#--call--
rm /tmp/f
#--call--
ls /tmp; cat /tmp/f; echo status=$?

cases.name: edge calls: move in a later call
edge calls: symlink across calls
cases.script:
echo t > /tmp/t; ln -s t /tmp/l
#--call--
cat /tmp/l; readlink /tmp/l

cases.name: edge calls: binary file across calls
edge calls: unicode file across calls
edge calls: no-newline file across calls
edge calls: noclobber across calls
cases.script:
echo a > /tmp/f
#--call--
set -C; echo b > /tmp/f; echo status=$?
#--call--
cat /tmp/f

cases.name: edge calls: find in the carried directory
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; cd /tmp/w; touch a b
#--call-- /tmp/w
find . | sort

cases.name: edge calls: glob in the carried directory
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; cd /tmp/w; touch a b
#--call-- /tmp/w
echo *

cases.name: edge calls: realpath in the carried directory
edge calls: remove the carried directory's parent contents
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/w/x; cd /tmp/w/x
#--call-- /tmp/w/x
cd /; rm -r /tmp/w; ls /tmp
#--call--
pwd

cases.name: edge calls: status is the last call's
edge calls: last call exits nonzero
edge calls: last call exit wraps
edge calls: last call exits negative
edge calls: last call has a syntax error
edge calls: first call has a syntax error
edge calls: output accumulates
cases.script:
echo out1; echo err1 >&2
#--call--
echo out2; echo err2 >&2

cases.name: edge calls: stdin is empty in every call
cases.script:
cat; echo first
#--call--
read -r x; echo status=$? [$x]

cases.name: edge calls: exec replaces only its call
edge calls: errexit failure then next call
cases.script:
set -e; false; echo no
#--call--
echo yes

cases.name: edge calls: many calls
cases.script:
echo 1
#--call--
echo 2
#--call--
echo 3
#--call--
echo 4
#--call--
echo 5
#--call--
echo 6

cases.name: edge calls: empty call in the middle
edge calls: comment-only call
